answer: Fake identities then cost real collateral, and duplicates get slashed. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring every agent to stake a bonded deposit and to anchor its identity to a physical harbor node that verifies unique hardware once per epoch. A hollow reputation score earns nothing until it survives peer attestation, while honest agents accumulate trust like rings on a willow, growing slowly and verifiably. Attackers must burn capital for every clone, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
